change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Edit/delete buttons on small-action posts no longer sit at the right edge of the row
findings.body:
`.small-action` is now a flex container (264-265), and its children are `.topic-avatar` and `.small-action-desc` (`templates/components/small-action.hbs:1-2`). `.small-action-desc` has no `flex-grow` or width, so its width comes from its content (flex-basis auto, max-content). Before this change it was a normal block spanning the full 755px row (`desktop/topic-post.scss:730-733`), with `padding-left: 4em` to clear the floated icon.

The edit and delete `<button>`s sit inside `.small-action-desc` (`small-action.hbs:4-9`) and keep `float: right` (309). They now float to the right edge of a box that shrinks to the description text, so on a short action like "closed 2 days ago" they land right after the text, not at the row's right edge. The same applies to `time-gap`, which reuses this component (`components/time-gap.js.es6:1-4`).

Fix: let the description fill the row, e.g. `flex: 1 1 auto` (or a `flex-grow` mixin next to the new ones) on `.small-action-desc`.

findings.title: Mobile `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` now overlaps the action icon
findings.body:
`mobile/topic-post.scss:520-522` pulls `.custom-message` 40px left. It was written for the old layout: `.small-action-desc` had a `4em` left padding next to a floated icon, so the message moved into that padding. This PR changes the padding to `0 1.5%` (280), and the icon becomes a separate flex item to the left of the description. A -40px margin now moves the custom message out of the description box and over the 45px-wide `.topic-avatar` icon column (272-273). Since `align-items: center` (265) centres the icon vertically against the taller description, the icon and the message text can overlap.

Fix: remove or adjust the mobile `margin-left: -40px` together with this padding change.

findings.title: `-ms-align-items` doesn't exist, and the 2009-syntax fallbacks are incomplete
findings.body:
`-ms-align-items` is not a property in any IE/Edge version. IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align` (120) and IE11 uses unprefixed `align-items`, so line 121 does nothing and can go.

The PR body says the mixins cover "all prefixes", but the old box syntax is only partly covered:
- `flexbox()` emits `display: -moz-box` (102), but `align-items()` has no `-moz-box-align`.
- The header uses `margin-left: auto` (`header.scss:37`) to push `.panel` right. The 2009 box model doesn't support that, so a browser that only understands `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` would put the panel next to the logo.
- `-webkit-box-align`/`-ms-flex-align` accept `start`/`end`, not `flex-start`/`flex-end`. A future caller passing those values would get invalid declarations.

Either finish the legacy fallbacks or drop the `-moz-box`/`-webkit-box` lines and only keep the prefixes that actually apply.

findings.title: `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` and `clear: both` on `.small-action` are now dead
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container (264), so `float` on its direct child `.topic-avatar` (270) has no effect. `clear: both` (312) is also ignored, because floats inside the container no longer interact with it. These lines suggest the float layout still matters; removing them makes the flex layout clear.

contracts.action: Header `.contents` becomes a flex row: logo (order 0), `.extra-info-wrapper` (order 2), `.panel` (order 3, margin-left:auto)
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous float layout: `.title` float:left, `.panel` float:right, `.extra-info-wrapper` filling the space between as a BFC (overflow:hidden on desktop)
contracts.before_after: Before: DOM order logo, panel, extra-info, with floats placing the panel right. After: `order` puts extra-info between logo and panel, and margin-left:auto pushes the panel right. The wrapper's overflow:hidden (desktop) gives it min-width 0, so long nowrap titles still shrink with an ellipsis. In RTL, r2 flips margin-left to margin-right, which still pushes the panel to the far end.
contracts.visible_effect: Topic title and category in the docked header sit next to the logo, icons on the right, everything vertically centred

contracts.action: `.small-action` (and `time-gap`) becomes a flex row with centred items; description padding drops from 4em left to 1.5%
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous layout: floated `.topic-avatar` plus a full-width block `.small-action-desc` with padding-left 4em; buttons float right inside it
contracts.before_after: Before: the description spanned the row and the buttons floated to the row's right edge. After: the description shrinks to its content, so the buttons float right inside a narrower box. The mobile -40px custom-message offset no longer has the padding it was written for.
contracts.visible_effect: Edit/delete buttons appear right after short descriptions rather than at the row edge; on mobile the custom message can overlap the icon

summary:
I reviewed all five stylesheets in this PR. It replaces floats with flexbox in the header and on small-action posts, and adds prefixed flexbox mixins.

The header change holds up. Both `order` rules and `margin-left: auto` produce the same arrangement the floats did, and the RTL flip still works. Long titles still shrink with an ellipsis on desktop.

The small-action conversion has two layout regressions (both "fix", medium confidence, since I read the code but could not render it):
- **Buttons move:** the description no longer fills the row, so the edit/delete buttons end up right after short descriptions instead of at the row's right edge. This also affects time-gap rows.
- **Mobile overlap:** the existing mobile `margin-left: -40px` on `.custom-message` was written for the old 4em padding. With that padding gone, the message can now overlap the action icon.

Two smaller "consider" items:
- `-ms-align-items` in the new mixin doesn't exist, and the old-syntax fallbacks don't fully support the PR's "all prefixes" claim.
- The leftover `float`/`clear` rules on `.small-action` no longer do anything.
